currentParagraphText: “Vampire gods don’t need to feed anymore, though it does remain beneficial to us. Just not a requirement,” Katherine explained something that both Iskar and the Sword Saint hadn’t known. “This means that if what Iskar said is true, you will be able to be a vampire without perhaps the biggest downside.”
